title: Gmail
description: Search and read Gmail messages and threads, send mail, and save attachments into the organization workspace. The add-on calls the Gmail API; the token is injected by the host and never enters the add-on process.

permissions.reason: Call the Gmail API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the mail connection
Save downloaded attachments into the organization workspace

descriptor.name: gmail
descriptor.title: Gmail tools
descriptor.description: Search and read Gmail, send mail, and save attachments to the workspace

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Gmail with the Gmail search syntax (e.g. "from:alice is:unread newer_than:7d"). Returns id, threadId, snippet, subject, from and date per match.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10)

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one Gmail message: headers (from/to/cc/subject/date), the text/plain body, and the attachment list with attachmentId, filename, mimeType and size.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a Gmail thread: every message in order with headers, text/plain bodies and attachment lists.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a plain-text email from the bound account. to and cc accept one address or several comma-separated addresses.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Download a Gmail attachment into the organization workspace. Get messageId and attachmentId from the attachments list of read_message or read_thread. Files up to 6 MB are supported.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound
